name: precision-kit
description: 28 project-agnostic engineering skills (mandatory project vault routed from CLAUDE.md, whole-project audit with scores and release verdict, incremental code map for ranged reads, works-on-every-machine portability with clean-room proof, recon, live modernization against current registries/advisories, modern integration, legacy cleanup, testing, verification, debugging, security, CI, docs, performance, migrations, UI checks) plus hooks that keep the code map and vault current, inject build/test commands at session start, and block commits that leak secrets, fail checks or leave the vault stale.

verify_on_commit.title: Verify on commit
verify_on_commit.description: Run the project's lint/typecheck/build/test for changed projects before every git commit and block on failures. Secret scanning always runs.

freshness_on_start.title: Live freshness note at session start
freshness_on_start.description: Show a one-line summary of outdated/vulnerable/deprecated dependencies at session start. Uses a daily cache refreshed in the background, so startup is never delayed.

vault_required.title: Require the project vault
vault_required.description: Block git commits in code projects until docs/vault (PRD, STATE, TOKENS, STACK, SCHEMA, PLAN) and the CLAUDE.md router exist and detected sections are in sync.
